name: python-fastapi-sqlite
title: FastAPI + SQLite service
blurb: Stateful JSON API: notes CRUD over a SQLite file, ordered SQL migrations applied once, per-request connections with WAL
default_description: A notes API backed by SQLite.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv -q .venv && uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest httpx ruff

verify.name: migrate
verify.cmd: .venv/bin/python -c "from {{ package_name }}.db import connect, migrate; c = connect(':memory:'); first = migrate(c); second = migrate(c); assert first == ['001_notes.sql'], first; assert second == [], second; print('migrations applied once:', first)"

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
set -e
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5452/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "port 5452 is already answering - stop that process before running this step"
  exit 1
fi
work=$(mktemp -d)
DB_PATH="$work/notes.db" PORT=5452 .venv/bin/uvicorn {{ package_name }}.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5452 > "$work/server.log" 2>&1 &
server=$!
trap 'kill -TERM $server 2>/dev/null || true; for _ in $(seq 1 20); do kill -0 $server 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.1; done; kill -KILL $server 2>/dev/null || true; wait $server 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
ready=1
for _ in $(seq 1 200); do
  if curl --max-time 2 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5452/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=0; break; fi
  sleep 0.25
done
if [ "$ready" -ne 0 ]; then cat "$work/server.log"; echo "the server did not answer in time"; exit 1; fi
kill -0 $server 2>/dev/null || { cat "$work/server.log"; echo "the server exited"; exit 1; }

check() {
  name=$1
  want=$2
  got=$3
  if [ "$want" != "$got" ]; then
    echo "FAIL $name: want [$want] got [$got]"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "ok $name"
}
status() { curl --max-time 10 -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$@"; }
json() { curl --max-time 10 -fsS "$@" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(json.load(sys.stdin), separators=(",",":")))'; }

check health '{"status":"ok","notes":0}' "$(curl --max-time 10 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5452/health)"
check create 201 "$(status -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"title":"shopping","body":"milk"}' http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes)"
check list '1:shopping:milk' "$(curl --max-time 10 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(",".join("%d:%s:%s" % (n["id"], n["title"], n["body"]) for n in json.load(sys.stdin)["notes"]))')"
check fetched '{"id":1,"title":"shopping","body":"milk"}' "$(curl --max-time 10 -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes/1 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k:d[k] for k in ("id","title","body")}, separators=(",",":")))')"
check patched 'shopping-final' "$(curl --max-time 10 -fsS -X PATCH -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"title":"shopping-final"}' http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes/1 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["title"])')"
check blank_title 422 "$(status -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{"title":"   "}' http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes)"
check missing_field 422 "$(status -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{}' http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes)"
check delete 204 "$(status -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes/1)"
check get_deleted 404 "$(status http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes/1)"
check not_found_detail '{"error":"not_found","detail":"no note with id 1"}' "$(curl --max-time 10 -sS http://127.0.0.1:5452/notes/1 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(json.load(sys.stdin)["detail"], separators=(",",":")))')"
test -f "$work/notes.db" || { echo "the database file was never created"; exit 1; }
echo "all contract checks passed"
